text: The design pressure of a line shall be the highest coincident of the following: maximum operating pressure plus 10 % (minimum 1.0 bar), the set pressure of the relief valve protecting the system, the shut-off head of the pump feeding the system, and the static head plus pressure at the tie-in; for steam and feedwater systems, the design pressure of the HRSG-connected piping is the drum or header design pressure of the equipment register.
